title: 'Big Short' investor Steve Eisman to discuss Nvidia, Anthropic and AI bull on CNBC
html:
Investor Steve Eisman is coming on CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Tuesday morning to talk about Nvidia, Anthropic and whether the AI bubble is in the midst of a deflation.

All eyes on Wall Street are on chipmaker Nvidia as it reports earnings on Tuesday after the bell while grappling with a potential Chinese espionage scandal. Frontier algorithm company Anthropic is expected to make its public debut on Thursday as concerns about the company's profitability potential linger amid the rapid and ongoing commodification of AI.
summary: Steve Eisman is appearing on "Squawk Box" on Tuesday.
